api/src/routers/__init__.py.name: Groups of requests
api/src/routers/__init__.py.description: Marks the folder that holds every group of incoming requests, one group per feature area of the platform.

api/src/routers/agent_run_sdk.py.name: Agent run hand-off
api/src/routers/agent_run_sdk.py.description: Lets the AI engine fetch one agent run with every step it took and start a new run without waiting for it to finish.

api/src/routers/agent_runs.py.name: Agent run history
api/src/routers/agent_runs.py.description: Lists, reruns, cancels and reviews AI agent runs, and flags weak results so the agent's instructions can be improved.

api/src/routers/agent_tuning.py.name: Agent instruction tuning
api/src/routers/agent_tuning.py.description: Turns an agent's flagged runs into one proposed instruction change, tests it against those runs, then applies it.

api/src/routers/agents.py.name: AI agents
api/src/routers/agents.py.description: Creates and manages AI agents: their instructions, tools, helpers they may pass work to, pictures and run figures.

api/src/routers/ai_models.py.name: AI provider setup
api/src/routers/ai_models.py.description: Lets administrators connect AI providers, choose models, and decide which model handles each job such as chat or summaries.

api/src/routers/ai_pricing.py.name: AI model prices
api/src/routers/ai_pricing.py.description: Keeps the price per unit for each AI model so spend reports show real costs.

api/src/routers/app_code_files.py.name: App source files
api/src/routers/app_code_files.py.description: Reads, saves and deletes an app's code files, and serves the built app and its assets so the app runs in the browser.

api/src/routers/app_embed_secrets.py.name: App embed keys
api/src/routers/app_embed_secrets.py.description: Creates and rotates the keys that let an app be shown on another website without exposing the rest of the platform.

api/src/routers/app_sdk_runtime.py.name: App toolkit delivery
api/src/routers/app_sdk_runtime.py.description: Hands apps the current shared building blocks while serving older pinned copies unchanged so existing apps keep working.

api/src/routers/applications.py.name: Apps and publishing
api/src/routers/applications.py.description: Creates, edits, publishes, rolls back and deletes the apps people build here, keeping drafts apart from the live version.

api/src/routers/audit.py.name: Audit trail
api/src/routers/audit.py.description: Shows who did what and when across the platform, and exports the full history to a file for review.

GET /api/agent-runs/{run_id}.name: Agent run detail
GET /api/agent-runs/{run_id}.description: Shows one agent run with each step it took, for the screens and for programs that report progress.

POST /api/agent-runs/enqueue.name: Queue an agent run
POST /api/agent-runs/enqueue.description: Accepts a request to start an agent run and hands back the run right away so the caller is not left waiting.

GET /api/agent-runs.name: Agent run history
GET /api/agent-runs.description: Lists past and current agent runs with filters, so you can see what the agents did and what it cost.

GET /api/agent-runs/metadata-keys.name: Run tag names
GET /api/agent-runs/metadata-keys.description: Lists the custom tags found on this agent's runs so the history screen can offer them as filters.

GET /api/agent-runs/metadata-values.name: Run tag values
GET /api/agent-runs/metadata-values.description: Lists the values recorded under one custom tag on this agent's runs, for narrowing the history.

GET /api/agent-runs/backfill-jobs.name: Summary backfill jobs
GET /api/agent-runs/backfill-jobs.description: Shows past and running jobs that filled in missing run summaries, for platform administrators.

GET /api/agent-runs/backfill-eligible.name: Backfill availability
GET /api/agent-runs/backfill-eligible.description: Checks quickly whether any runs still need summaries, which decides whether the Backfill button appears.

POST /api/agent-runs/{run_id}/rerun.name: Rerun an agent run
POST /api/agent-runs/{run_id}/rerun.description: Starts a fresh run with the same input as an earlier one, in the background.

POST /api/agent-runs/{run_id}/cancel.name: Cancel an agent run
POST /api/agent-runs/{run_id}/cancel.description: Stops a queued or running agent run and marks it cancelled.

POST /api/agent-runs/{run_id}/verdict.name: Flag a run result
POST /api/agent-runs/{run_id}/verdict.description: Records whether a finished run was good or bad, so weak runs can be gathered for tuning.

DELETE /api/agent-runs/{run_id}/verdict.name: Remove run flag
DELETE /api/agent-runs/{run_id}/verdict.description: Clears the good or bad mark on a run so it no longer counts toward tuning.

GET /api/agent-runs/{run_id}/flag-conver.name: Flag discussion
GET /api/agent-runs/{run_id}/flag-conver.description: Shows the conversation where the tuning assistant and you discuss a flagged run.

POST /api/agent-runs/{run_id}/flag-conve.name: Reply in flag discussion
POST /api/agent-runs/{run_id}/flag-conve.description: Adds your message to a flagged run's discussion and returns the assistant's reply straight away.

POST /api/agent-runs/{run_id}/regenerate.name: Rebuild run summary
POST /api/agent-runs/{run_id}/regenerate.description: Throws away a run's summary and queues a fresh one.

POST /api/agent-runs/{run_id}/dry-run.name: Test new instructions
POST /api/agent-runs/{run_id}/dry-run.description: Replays a past run against proposed agent instructions to show how the answer would change.

POST /api/agent-runs/execute.name: Run an agent now
POST /api/agent-runs/execute.description: Runs an agent start to finish and returns its result, for programs that need the answer immediately.

POST /api/agent-runs/backfill-summaries.name: Fill in missing summaries
POST /api/agent-runs/backfill-summaries.description: Queues summary writing for every run that lacks one, with an estimate of the AI spend involved.

GET /api/agent-runs/backfill-jobs/{job_i.name: Backfill progress
GET /api/agent-runs/backfill-jobs/{job_i.description: Shows how far a summary backfill job has got, for platform administrators.

POST /api/agent-runs/backfill-jobs/{job_.name: Stop a backfill job
POST /api/agent-runs/backfill-jobs/{job_.description: Marks a running summary backfill as cancelled so the screens stop waiting on it.

POST /api/agents/{agent_id}/tuning-sessi.name: Propose instruction changes
POST /api/agents/{agent_id}/tuning-sessi.description: Reads this agent's flagged runs and drafts one combined change to its instructions.

POST /api/agents/{agent_id}/tuning-sessi.name: Test tuning proposal
POST /api/agents/{agent_id}/tuning-sessi.description: Replays every flagged run against a proposed instruction change so you can compare answers before applying.

POST /api/agents/{agent_id}/tuning-sessi.name: Apply tuning proposal
POST /api/agents/{agent_id}/tuning-sessi.description: Saves the proposed instructions, keeps a record of the old version, and clears the flags it addressed.

GET /api/agents.name: Agent list
GET /api/agents.description: Lists the AI agents you are allowed to see, with enough detail for the agent screens.

POST /api/agents.name: Create an agent
POST /api/agents.description: Sets up a new AI agent with its instructions and sharing scope; platform administrators can create any kind.

GET /api/agents/accessible-tools.name: Assignable tools
GET /api/agents/accessible-tools.description: Lists the tools you may give your agents, based on what your role already allows.

GET /api/agents/stats/fleet.name: All agents performance
GET /api/agents/stats/fleet.description: Summarises runs, success and cost across every agent for a chosen number of days.

GET /api/agents/{agent_id}.name: Agent details
GET /api/agents/{agent_id}.description: Shows one agent's settings, instructions and sharing.

PUT /api/agents/{agent_id}.name: Update an agent
PUT /api/agents/{agent_id}.description: Changes an agent's name, instructions, model or sharing; administrators can change any agent.

DELETE /api/agents/{agent_id}.name: Delete an agent
DELETE /api/agents/{agent_id}.description: Permanently removes an agent and its settings.

POST /api/agents/{agent_id}/promote.name: Share an agent widely
POST /api/agents/{agent_id}/promote.description: Moves a private agent into its organization so colleagues can use it.

GET /api/agents/{agent_id}/stats.name: Agent performance
GET /api/agents/{agent_id}/stats.description: Shows how often this agent ran, how often it succeeded and what it cost recently.

GET /api/agents/{agent_id}/tools.name: Agent tools
GET /api/agents/{agent_id}/tools.description: Lists the tools this agent may use when it works.

GET /api/agents/{agent_id}/delegations.name: Agent hand-offs
GET /api/agents/{agent_id}/delegations.description: Lists the other agents this agent may pass work to.

POST /api/agents/{agent_id}/logo.name: Upload agent logo
POST /api/agents/{agent_id}/logo.description: Sets the small square picture shown next to the agent's name.

DELETE /api/agents/{agent_id}/logo.name: Remove agent logo
DELETE /api/agents/{agent_id}/logo.description: Clears the agent's picture so the default one is shown.

GET /api/admin/ai/behavior.name: AI behaviour settings
GET /api/admin/ai/behavior.description: Shows platform-wide AI behaviour settings that apply to every AI feature.

PUT /api/admin/ai/behavior.name: Change AI behaviour
PUT /api/admin/ai/behavior.description: Saves the platform-wide AI behaviour settings used by every AI feature.

GET /api/admin/ai/connections.name: AI provider connections
GET /api/admin/ai/connections.description: Lists the AI services the platform can use, with their access keys hidden.

POST /api/admin/ai/connections.name: Connect an AI provider
POST /api/admin/ai/connections.description: Adds a new AI service to the platform by storing its address and access key.

POST /api/admin/ai/connections/verify.name: Check provider details
POST /api/admin/ai/connections/verify.description: Tests a provider's address and key before saving them, and lists what it can offer.

PATCH /api/admin/ai/connections/{connect.name: Edit provider connection
PATCH /api/admin/ai/connections/{connect.description: Changes a connected AI service's details or access key.

DELETE /api/admin/ai/connections/{connec.name: Remove provider connection
DELETE /api/admin/ai/connections/{connec.description: Disconnects an AI service so no agent can use it.

POST /api/admin/ai/connections/{connecti.name: Test provider connection
POST /api/admin/ai/connections/{connecti.description: Sends a small request to a connected AI service to confirm it still answers.

GET /api/admin/ai/connections/{connectio.name: Provider models
GET /api/admin/ai/connections/{connectio.description: Lists the models an AI service offers so administrators can choose one.

GET /api/admin/ai/catalog.name: Model catalogue
GET /api/admin/ai/catalog.description: Lists the AI services and models the platform knows about, kept in step with the public model list.

POST /api/admin/ai/catalog/refresh.name: Refresh model catalogue
POST /api/admin/ai/catalog/refresh.description: Updates the model list now instead of waiting for the scheduled refresh.

GET /api/admin/ai/profiles.name: Model profiles
GET /api/admin/ai/profiles.description: Lists the ready-made model settings administrators can hand to agents and chat.

POST /api/admin/ai/profiles.name: Add model profile
POST /api/admin/ai/profiles.description: Creates a reusable set of model settings with a name people can recognise.

POST /api/admin/ai/profiles/merge.name: Merge model profiles
POST /api/admin/ai/profiles/merge.description: Combines duplicate model settings into one so anything using either keeps working.

PATCH /api/admin/ai/profiles/{profile_id.name: Edit model profile
PATCH /api/admin/ai/profiles/{profile_id.description: Changes a reusable model set-up, such as its model, limits or name.

POST /api/admin/ai/profiles/{profile_id}.name: Check model profile
POST /api/admin/ai/profiles/{profile_id}.description: Sends a test request using a model profile to confirm it works.

DELETE /api/admin/ai/profiles/{profile_i.name: Delete model profile
DELETE /api/admin/ai/profiles/{profile_i.description: Removes a reusable model set-up that is no longer needed.

GET /api/admin/ai/assignments.name: Model assignments
GET /api/admin/ai/assignments.description: Shows which model setting is used for each job, such as chat, summaries or image making.

PUT /api/admin/ai/assignments/{assignmen.name: Assign model to job
PUT /api/admin/ai/assignments/{assignmen.description: Chooses which model setting handles a particular job.

DELETE /api/admin/ai/assignments/{assign.name: Reset a model assignment
DELETE /api/admin/ai/assignments/{assign.description: Removes the chosen model for a job so the platform default applies again.

GET /api/settings/ai/pricing.name: AI prices
GET /api/settings/ai/pricing.description: Lists what each AI model costs per unit, used for spend figures.

POST /api/settings/ai/pricing.name: Add model price
POST /api/settings/ai/pricing.description: Records a price for an AI model so its usage can be costed.

PUT /api/settings/ai/pricing/{pricing_id.name: Update model price
PUT /api/settings/ai/pricing/{pricing_id.description: Corrects the price recorded for an AI model.

DELETE /api/settings/ai/pricing/{pricing.name: Remove model price
DELETE /api/settings/ai/pricing/{pricing.description: Deletes a model's price so its usage is no longer costed.

GET /api/applications/{app_id}/files.name: App file list
GET /api/applications/{app_id}/files.description: Lists every code file in an app so the builder can show its file tree.

GET /api/applications/{app_id}/files/{fi.name: Read an app file
GET /api/applications/{app_id}/files/{fi.description: Returns the contents of one app file for the code editor.

PUT /api/applications/{app_id}/files/{fi.name: Save an app file
PUT /api/applications/{app_id}/files/{fi.description: Creates or overwrites one app file as code is written or pasted.

DELETE /api/applications/{app_id}/files/.name: Delete an app file
DELETE /api/applications/{app_id}/files/.description: Removes one file from an app's source.

GET /api/applications/{app_id}/render.name: Run app code
GET /api/applications/{app_id}/render.description: Hands the browser all of an app's code already translated, so the app starts without a build step.

GET /api/applications/{app_id}/bundle-ma.name: Built app contents
GET /api/applications/{app_id}/bundle-ma.description: Lists the files and details of an app's most recent build.

GET /api/applications/{app_id}/bundle-as.name: Built app file
GET /api/applications/{app_id}/bundle-as.description: Delivers one file from an app's build, such as an image or stylesheet.

GET /api/applications/{app_id}/dist/{pat.name: Finished app files
GET /api/applications/{app_id}/dist/{pat.description: Delivers the finished files of an app that was built outside the platform.

GET /api/applications/{app_id}/dependenc.name: App add-on packages
GET /api/applications/{app_id}/dependenc.description: Lists the extra code packages an app depends on.

PUT /api/applications/{app_id}/dependenc.name: Set app add-on packages
PUT /api/applications/{app_id}/dependenc.description: Replaces the list of extra code packages an app depends on.

POST /api/applications/{app_id}/embed-se.name: Add embed key
POST /api/applications/{app_id}/embed-se.description: Creates a key that lets another website show this app inside its own page.

GET /api/applications/{app_id}/embed-sec.name: App embed keys
GET /api/applications/{app_id}/embed-sec.description: Lists the keys used to embed this app elsewhere, without showing the key values.

PATCH /api/applications/{app_id}/embed-s.name: Update embed key
PATCH /api/applications/{app_id}/embed-s.description: Changes an embed key's label or switches it off.

DELETE /api/applications/{app_id}/embed-.name: Delete embed key
DELETE /api/applications/{app_id}/embed-.description: Revokes an embed key so pages using it stop working.

GET /api/app-sdk/v1/manifest.name: App toolkit pointer
GET /api/app-sdk/v1/manifest.description: Tells an app which version of the shared building blocks to load.

GET /api/app-sdk/assets/{fingerprint}.js.name: App toolkit file
GET /api/app-sdk/assets/{fingerprint}.js.description: Serves one exact version of the shared building blocks so older apps keep working unchanged.

POST /api/applications.name: Create an app
POST /api/applications.description: Starts a new app with its name, web address and who may use it.

GET /api/applications.name: App list
GET /api/applications.description: Lists the apps you can open, with their names, web addresses and live status.

POST /api/applications/sdk/update.name: Update app toolkits
POST /api/applications/sdk/update.description: Moves many apps onto the current shared building blocks in one go.

GET /api/applications/{slug}.name: App details
GET /api/applications/{slug}.description: Shows one app's name, web address, description and who may use it.

PATCH /api/applications/{app_id}.name: Edit an app
PATCH /api/applications/{app_id}.description: Changes an app's name, description, picture or who may use it.

DELETE /api/applications/{app_id}.name: Delete an app
DELETE /api/applications/{app_id}.description: Permanently removes an app and its saved code.

GET /api/applications/{app_id}/draft.name: App draft
GET /api/applications/{app_id}/draft.description: Shows the working copy of an app that has not been published yet.

PUT /api/applications/{app_id}/draft.name: Save app draft
PUT /api/applications/{app_id}/draft.description: Stores the working copy of an app without publishing it.

POST /api/applications/{app_id}/deploy.name: Publish an app build
POST /api/applications/{app_id}/deploy.description: Builds the app's current code and switches the live app over to the new build.

GET /api/applications/{app_id}/source.name: Download app code
GET /api/applications/{app_id}/source.description: Packages an app's code so it can be kept, reviewed or moved elsewhere.

POST /api/applications/{app_id}/sdk/upda.name: Update app toolkit
POST /api/applications/{app_id}/sdk/upda.description: Rebuilds one app against the current shared building blocks.

POST /api/applications/{app_id}/publish.name: Publish app changes
POST /api/applications/{app_id}/publish.description: Queues a reliable publish of the app's current code and makes it live when ready.

POST /api/applications/{app_id}/replace.name: Relink app location
POST /api/applications/{app_id}/replace.description: Points an app at its new folder after its code files were moved or renamed.

POST /api/applications/swap-slugs.name: Swap app addresses
POST /api/applications/swap-slugs.description: Swaps the web addresses of two apps so a replacement can take over the old link.

POST /api/applications/{app_id}/validate.name: Check app code
POST /api/applications/{app_id}/validate.description: Reads an app's code and reports missing pieces or problems before publishing.

GET /api/applications/{app_id}/export.name: Export app
GET /api/applications/{app_id}/export.description: Downloads an app's full definition as a single file for backup or transfer.

POST /api/applications/{app_id}/rollback.name: Revert to earlier build
POST /api/applications/{app_id}/rollback.description: Puts a previous published build back live.

POST /api/applications/{app_id}/logo.name: Upload app logo
POST /api/applications/{app_id}/logo.description: Sets the small square picture shown for the app.

DELETE /api/applications/{app_id}/logo.name: Remove app logo
DELETE /api/applications/{app_id}/logo.description: Clears the app's picture so the default is shown.

GET /api/audit.name: Audit history
GET /api/audit.description: Lists recorded actions across the platform, newest first, with who did what.

POST /api/audit/exports.name: Export audit history
POST /api/audit/exports.description: Starts building a file of the full audit history, including archived events.

GET /api/audit/exports/{job_id}/download.name: Download audit file
GET /api/audit/exports/{job_id}/download.description: Hands over the finished audit history file once it is ready.

GET /api/audit/{event_id}/explain.name: Explain an access decision
GET /api/audit/{event_id}/explain.description: Walks through why a particular person was allowed or refused an action.
